mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP indicates strong economic growth, which positively impacts corporate earnings and drives up S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher when UNRATE is below 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When both payroll employment (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) improve simultaneously, it indicates a robust labor market, leading to increased economic activity and higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative when both PAYEMS and UNRATE improve (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% during a monetary tightening cycle leads to higher borrowing costs, reducing corporate profitability and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals increased economic output, leading to higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand in the housing market, leading to broader economic growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of housing starts growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 250 indicates high inflation, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when CPIAUCSL exceeds 250 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals strong labor market growth, leading to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher when PAYEMS increases by >100,000 (t-test p > 0.05).
